Name: All Seeds All Seasons
Author: NemoJr
Description:
[size=5][b]Details:[/b][/size]

This mod will add all the out-of-season seeds to Pierre's and JojaMart's stock, so any seed can be purchased at any time, regardless of season. Also adds Blueberry & Corn seeds to JojaMart's summer stock, to be consistent with Pierre's General Store.

If you purchase a JojaMart membership, the items added by this mod will update their prices the next day.


Note: If you think certain elements added in SDV 1.5 makes this mod redundant, you can compare them and decide for yourself.
Details under the spoiler tag, just in case.

[spoiler][url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Pierre%27s_Missing_Stocklist]Relevant page on Stardew Valley Wiki[/url][/spoiler]


[size=4][b]Variations:[/b][/size]

This mod has a few options to choose from.
They can all be found under the [b]Files[/b] tab.
Use [b]only[/b] 1 of these:

[size=3][b]Main:[/b][/size] All seeds you could normally buy from Pierre's or JojaMart (in the proper year & season) can now be bought at any time.

[size=3][b]Alt1:[/b][/size] Same as the main file, except you won't get access to Year 2 crops before their vanilla schedule (e.g. Red Cabbage will first be available in Year 2 Summer; after that, it will be available in every season). Affected crops are: Rice, Garlic (spring), Red Cabbage (summer), and Artichoke (fall).

[size=3][b]Alt2:[/b][/size] Same as the main file, but also adds many extra seeds typically not found in regular stores. Added items are: Mixed Seeds (50g), Spring Seeds, Summer Seeds, Fall Seeds, Winter Seeds, Strawberry Seeds (100g each), Ancient Seeds, Rare Seed, Coffee Bean, Tea Sapling (1000g each).

[size=3][b]Alt2a:[/b][/size] Same as Alt2, except it adds the extra seeds only to Pierre's stock, to avoid conflict with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2658]Lore-Friendly JojaMart Prices[/url].

[size=3][b]Alt3:[/b][/size] A combination of Alt1 & Alt2: Same rules as Alt1 for Year 2 crops, and adds the extra seeds from Alt2 with some conditions of their own.
Details under the spoiler tag.

[spoiler][b]Mixed Seeds:[/b] No conditions; these are available from the start.

[b]Ancient Seeds & Tea Sapling:[/b] Available once you've unlocked their respective crafting recipes.
*Note the shop inventories will update the [i]next day[/i] after you get the recipe.

[b]All other seeds:[/b] Available [i]after[/i] the first season/period that they can be planted.
e.g. Strawberry & Spring Seeds will be available starting in Year 1 Summer, Coffee Bean & Summer Seeds in Year 1 Fall, etc.

This results in a more natural early-game flow (closer to vanilla) since you won't be able to buy & plant these special seeds en masse the first chance you get, but you'll still have that convenience later, starting with the next year (or earlier, if you rush the greenhouse).[/spoiler]
(Thanks to [b]Mordecai71[/b] for the suggestion)

[size=3][b]Alt3a:[/b][/size] Same as Alt3, except it adds the extra seeds only to Pierre's stock, to avoid conflict with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2658]Lore-Friendly JojaMart Prices[/url].



[size=4][b]Installation:[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5005]Shop Tile Framework[/url] installed, with all its requirements.
[*]Extract the contents of the zip file to your [b]Stardew Valley\Mods[/b] folder, just like any other SMAPI mod.
[/list]
If you're new to Stardew Valley modding, [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started]take a look at this[/url].



[size=4][b]Compatibility:[/b][/size]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2658]Lore-Friendly JojaMart Prices[/url] - It doesn't play nice* with [b]Alt2[/b] version; use [b]Alt2a[/b] instead. Otherwise fully compatible and highly recommended.

[spoiler]* It changes the prices of extra seeds I've added to JojaMart to their default values, which are ridiculous, since they weren't meant to be sold at a regular store. You can use them together if you don't mind this. Pierre's prices are unaffected.[/spoiler]
